description: This module has two possible ways of operation.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: The destination directory to extract files to.

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: The path to the 7z executable to use for extracting files from the ISO. If not provided, it assumes the value 7z.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: A list of files to extract from the image. Extracting directories does not work.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If true, it replaces the remote file when contents are different than the source. If false, the file is only extracted and copied if the destination does not already exist. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: The ISO image to extract files from.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password used to decrypt files from the ISO. It is only used if 7z is used. The password is used as a command line argument to 7z. This is a potential security risk that allows passwords to be revealed if someone else can list running processes on the same machine in the right moment.

examples:
- name: Extract kernel and ramdisk from a LiveCD
  community.general.iso_extract:
    image: /tmp/rear-test.iso
    dest: /tmp/virt-rear/
    files:
      - isolinux/kernel
      - isolinux/initrd.cgz
